item.title: LMSYS Pushes DeepSeek-V4-Pro to 271 Tokens Per Second on H20 GPUs
item.summary: LMSYS Org reports that DeepSeek-V4-Pro, a 1.6-trillion-parameter MoE model, reaches 271 output tokens per second on NVIDIA H20 GPUs — just 1.42× behind B300 — using a scenario-specific SGLang serving stack with optimizations including DSpark and a 10.14× KV cache capacity expansion.
